name: HEIC to JPG Batch Converter

seo.title: HEIC to JPG Batch Converter — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Convert HEIC/HEIF photos to JPEG locally in the browser with bounded batch processing.

assumptions: A bundled libheif/WASM decoder is lazy-loaded only after this route opens.
limitations: HDR/wide-gamut source data may be tone-mapped to the browser canvas colour space; metadata is not preserved by default.
